stories.sectionSubtitle: Listen to the experiences of farmers who integrated KHAAD BHARAT Biochar into their agricultural workflows.

items.name: Ramesh Kumar
items.summary: Saved immense pumping cost and achieved rich cotton yields.
items.story: Ramesh Kumar integrated KHAAD BHARAT Biochar into his 5-acre farm. By holding soil moisture during critical heat waves, he reduced his diesel pump irrigation runs from twice a week to once every ten days. His cotton fibers showed superior length and density.

items.name: Savitri Devi
items.impact: 20% higher yield, lower chemical fertilizer reliance
items.summary: Transformed dry sandy patches into fertile vegetable beds.
items.story: Savitri Devi manages a vegetable nursery. Mixing biochar with traditional compost allowed her sandy soil to retain vital nitrogen nutrients. She observed faster root development in tomato and chili saplings and decreased spending on urea inputs.

items.name: Gurpreet Singh
items.impact: Enhanced soil carbon, reduced fertilizer run-off
items.summary: Prevented nutrient leaching in sandy potato soils.
items.story: Gurpreet realized his fertilizer spends were rising while soil yields plateued. Adding KHAAD BHARAT Biochar created a porous carbon sponge that locked in soil nutrients. His potato size remained uniform, commanding top prices in the market.
